rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun phrase for fluency in a language.

example.english: Your English fluency is already good enough for everyday work.
example.traditional: 你嘅英文流利程度，已經足夠應付日常工作喇。
example.jyutping: nei5 ge3 jing1 man2 lau4 lei6 cing4 dou6 ji5 ging1 zuk1 gau3 jing3 fu6 jat6 soeng4 gung1 zok3 laa3

rows.note: Use this for the smooth flow of speech, writing, movement, or another process.

example.english: The fluency of this article is very high, and it is not awkward to read at all.
example.traditional: 呢篇文章嘅流暢程度好高，讀落一啲都唔拗口。
example.jyutping: ne1 pin1 man4 zoeng1 ge3 lau4 coeng3 cing4 dou6 hou2 gou1 duk6 lok6 jat1 di1 dou1 m4 aau3 hau2

rows.note: Use this when fluency means performing a practiced skill with ease and accuracy.

example.english: Their fluency at playing the piano is really impressive.
example.traditional: 佢彈鋼琴嘅熟練程度，真係令人佩服。
example.jyutping: keoi5 daan6 gong3 kam4 ge3 suk6 lin6 cing4 dou6 zan1 hai6 ling6 jan4 pui3 fuk6
